factor_base.construction: weight-three normal-basis mask orbits plus the first 4000 distinct weight-four cyclic-mask orbits from the frozen geometry

resource_envelope.timing_role: The one-billion-tests/second rate is a deliberately favorable admission assumption, not a measurement or performance claim.

admission_rule.ordinary_population: uniform points in the prime-order N83 subgroup
admission_rule.pair_certificate_model: Store target-independent exact pair-sum certificates, each representing at most one signed-Frobenius orbit, and test concrete triples against them. Every pair/triple comparison determines at most one target.
admission_rule.separator_model: An exact Wagner-style separator must be an efficiently computable quotient homomorphism on the working subgroup.
admission_rule.positive_control: A planted target made from one stored pair certificate and one scheduled triple must be found and replayed, but this sanity check does not satisfy the ordinary-population rule.

inadmissible: counting a planted target as evidence of ordinary-query coverage
treating a non-homomorphic coordinate prefix as an additive separator
crediting one folded certificate with more than 166 concrete pair sums without an exact multiplicity proof
rerunning the negative SAT or fixed-offset paths
raising memory, counted-test, or success caps after seeing a result
calling an asymptotic generic-group lower bound an impossibility proof for this structured fixed base
decision: Run no experiment unless the native verifier proves that a proposed separator or pair-certificate pilot can meet the ordinary-population admission rule inside the frozen envelope.
